notes: Corrected the System Scan introduction. The previous version said components and sensors only, and that was wrong: the scan also looks at the monitoring, benchmarking and game software you have installed — including individual game titles…
It now says so up front, and explains why it matters: some of those tools unlock readings Sigil cannot get on its own, and Sigil will recommend the ones worth adding.

The privacy wording is narrower and checkable. Sigil records what is installed, never what you do with it, and nothing leaves the machine — the scan makes no outbound connections at all, and the snapshot is a file on your PC you can open.
